subject: Trading
title: Adapting to Changing Markets
description: One-minute skill: Adapting to Changing Markets.

hook.text: Strategies that worked in the 1990s stopped working in the 2010s. Markets evolve, and traders must evolve with them.

buildup.text: Algorithmic trading, ETF flows, and central bank intervention changed market structure fundamentally since 2008.

discovery.text: Traders who adapted—like Druckenmiller shifting from currencies to equities—continued to thrive in new environments.

twist.text: Value investing underperformed for a decade as growth stocks and tech dominated. Even the best methods have dry spells.

climax.text: The greatest traders don't marry one approach. They keep the principles but update the playbook as markets change.

punchline.text: Adapt the method. Keep the discipline.

quiz.question: Why must traders adapt their strategies over time?
options: Market structure evolves and strategies that once worked may stop working
